answer: Give every agent one ember of trust kept alive only by steady, verified work: a newcomer earns it after unrelated veterans check its first jobs, and the ember dims when work stops, so idle clones fade on their own. Each verified job sends an echo signed by a different checker, and trust grows only when echoes arrive from many independent voices, never one clique. If a duplicate is caught, the penalty ripples outward, freezing every identity that vouched for it. Sybil farms must fund and sustain a live ember plus real echoes for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
